item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-006f016909b8eb0d","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 11 March 2023, government agencies reported that implementation of the PDL-145T had begun: BCeCo had launched construction of 313 infrastructures (189 schools and 124 health centres) in 48 territories, while contracts with 70 small and medium enterprises covered a further 731 infrastructures. The agency expected initial deliveries from April, with later deliveries projected through July.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.4","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns implementation during 2023; the report records planned and ongoing works, not completed outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The government communication attributes the PDL-145T to an ordinance taken by President Félix Tshisekedi on 12 January 2023 and describes implementation by executive agencies under the government.","limitations":["Reported by the executive branch; delivery projections were not independently verified in this document.","The source does not establish the final quality, distribution, or completion rate of the infrastructure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-006f016909b8eb0d","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The government reported that 38,000 kilometres of agricultural feeder roads were included in the PDL-145T and that initial government advances had been paid; in the CFEF area, studies were complete but the tender process still awaited authorization.","question_ids":["5B.6","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Concerns the programme's 2023 planning and early implementation stage.","ruler_attribution":"The programme was presented as organized by the President's January 2023 ordinance and implemented through government agencies.","limitations":["The report documents financing and preparation, not completed road construction or socioeconomic effects.","The figures and status are government-reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-006f016909b8eb0d","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Minister of Communication stated that a system was ready to allow citizens to monitor each PDL-145T project by telephone and view infrastructure execution details.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported as an intended or newly available accountability mechanism in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The mechanism was described by the national government in connection with a presidentially organized development programme.","limitations":["The document does not show usage, completeness, or independent verification of the monitoring system."]},{"source_id":"SRC-df207f617e559f32","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A 2015 World Bank assessment found that the DRC had sustained growth and macroeconomic stability but remained vulnerable to external shocks, with recommendations to reinvest extractive revenues, diversify the mining sector, reduce dollarization, formalize artisanal mining, and improve revenue mobilization.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.9","5B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Historical context predating 2023; it identifies inherited structural conditions rather than a 2023 action by Tshisekedi.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to Félix Tshisekedi; the assessment concerns the DRC's structural economic conditions and prior government policies.","limitations":["The document is from 2015 and cannot by itself establish 2023 policy, implementation, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-df207f617e559f32","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The World Bank reported that natural-resource revenues represented 36% of GDP in 2012, while mobilized revenue did not exceed 14.4% of GDP; it also reported high dollarization, with 91% of credits and 86% of deposits denominated in dollars.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical quantitative baseline, substantially preceding 2023.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["These figures are not 2023 measurements and do not demonstrate responsibility or performance during Tshisekedi's 2023 period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d8457287dbc725e2","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"At the August 2023 annual performance review for primary, secondary, and technical education, the education minister ordered monitoring of the 2016–2025 education reforms and review of the previous year's recommendations, with 400 participants involved.","question_ids":["6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns a 2023 review and evaluation process.","ruler_attribution":"The action was taken by the education ministry within Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["The source records the review process but not its findings or subsequent corrections."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d8457287dbc725e2","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The education minister reported that some provincial directors were allegedly creating parallel networks to produce false school certificates, undercounting pupils, and withholding free primary certificates; he threatened sanctions and ordered non-compliant officials to remain in Kinshasa until they complied.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.4","6B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reported government enforcement concerns and responses in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations and threatened sanctions were made by a cabinet minister in Tshisekedi's government, not directly by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The document reports the minister's allegations and orders without independent findings or evidence that sanctions were completed.","The scope and frequency of the alleged conduct are unspecified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0527a42208054ca4","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 6 February 2023, demonstrators in Goma barricaded major roads and demanded withdrawal of the East African Community force, alleging it was inactive against the M23; police used tear gas to disperse them, while the provincial governor personally appealed for calm.","question_ids":["2B.7","3B.8","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns a domestic security and protest episode during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes actions by police and the provincial governor; it does not report a direct presidential order.","limitations":["The report does not establish whether police conduct caused injuries or whether Tshisekedi personally directed the response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-98a4cf8c9c760685","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported credible allegations of mass rape and summary killings by M23 fighters in areas of North Kivu vacated in early 2023, and called for Congolese and UN investigations, prosecution through the chain of command, and assistance for survivors.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.1","3B.4","3B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Concerns alleged abuses and the required response during the 2023 M23 withdrawal period.","ruler_attribution":"The report calls on DRC authorities but does not establish that Tshisekedi personally ordered, tolerated, or corrected the alleged abuses.","limitations":["The allegations concern M23 and the document does not report whether DRC investigations or remedies were completed.","The source is an advocacy organization's assessment, though it refers to witness accounts and UN reporting."]},{"source_id":"SRC-98a4cf8c9c760685","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported that M23's territorial expansion had forced more than 800,000 people to flee their homes, while January 2023 withdrawals allowed some key roads to reopen and displaced people to begin returning gradually.","question_ids":["2B.7","3B.6","3B.7","3B.10","6B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The displacement baseline began before 2023; the reported withdrawals and gradual returns occurred during early 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the withdrawals to M23's actions in the context of the Nairobi and Luanda processes, not directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The figures and causal attribution are reported by Amnesty and are not a direct evaluation of presidential performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dcac22996848363a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The proposed 2023 central-government budget was balanced at 29,511.1 billion Congolese francs (about USD 14.6 billion), a 32.6% increase over the 2022 budget, with projected GDP growth of 6.7% and average inflation of 8.9%.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.9","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Concerns the budget proposal prepared for fiscal year 2023; it is a planned allocation rather than an executed result.","ruler_attribution":"The budget was submitted by the Sama Lukonde government pursuant to instructions from President Félix Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish parliamentary approval, execution, or results.","The macroeconomic assumptions were projections."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dcac22996848363a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The 2023 budget documents prioritized mobilizing domestic resources, raising fiscal pressure toward the sub-Saharan benchmark of 17.6%, continuing tax and customs reforms, and intensifying management controls.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns the government's stated 2023 fiscal programme.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were part of the government programme under Tshisekedi's presidency.","limitations":["The source reports planned policies, not implementation or revenue outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dcac22996848363a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi instructed that the 2023 budget should significantly prioritize investment spending in basic social sectors, including health and education, rural development, and nationally integrating infrastructure.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","6B.2","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns the President's stated budget priorities for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The instruction is directly attributed to President Félix Tshisekedi in the report of the 64th Council of Ministers meeting.","limitations":["The source does not show the final budget composition or execution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b1d3b27fab12bedd","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Following the violent 30 August 2023 Goma demonstration, the government reported 43 deaths, 56 injuries, and 158 arrests; it stated that injured people were receiving hospital treatment and supported an investigation by the Goma military prosecutor, with promises of prompt trials and no impunity.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns a major domestic-security incident and announced government response in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The response was announced by the central government under Tshisekedi; the source does not identify a personal presidential order.","limitations":["The same report notes that political actors accused security forces of committing a crime and that the death toll had been disputed.","It does not establish the independence, completion, or outcomes of the military investigation or trials."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a8f3c900ef7dad8","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"A five-member mixed international expert team audited the electoral register from 15–20 May 2023 using international election-management and IDEA-related standards, reviewed the internal audit and election systems, and declared the register reliable while issuing recommendations to improve credibility and public confidence.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.10","7B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 electoral preparation period.","ruler_attribution":"The audit was commissioned by the independent electoral commission; the source does not establish that Tshisekedi controlled the audit's findings.","limitations":["The source is the CENI's own publication and does not present dissenting assessments.","A reliable register does not by itself establish that the election was fully contestable or free from other violations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a8f3c900ef7dad8","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The CENI reported that its voter-registration data-cleaning system removed non-conforming records, including duplicates, minors' registrations, multiple registrations, and photograph-of-photograph entries; it reported 43,955,181 registered voters compared with 40,371,439 in the previous cycle.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns electoral administration during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The activity was carried out by the CENI, a constitutionally relevant institution, without direct attribution to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The figures and cleaning claims are reported by the CENI and were not independently verified in this document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3edf64f1400a8240","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A January 2023 strategic-planning workshop for DRC labour inspection trained 11 labour inspectors, including two women and two mining inspectors, conducted two construction-site inspection exercises, and produced a six-month strategic plan and a 2023 action plan with performance indicators.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.4","6B.9","8B.2","8B.4","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns institutional capacity-building undertaken in January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The workshop was conducted under the patronage of the labour ministry with ILO support; it is not directly attributed to Tshisekedi personally.","limitations":["The source does not report whether the plan was funded, implemented, or effective after the workshop."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3edf64f1400a8240","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Inspector General of Labour acknowledged that the labour-inspection system faced significant weaknesses preventing it from fully performing its legal role and identified inspector training, including peer-based training of trainers, as a corrective action.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.4","6B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Institutional finding and proposed corrective measure from January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding and corrective proposal came from the Inspector General of Labour within the government system, not directly from Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not specify the weaknesses' scale, causes, or subsequent correction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-daf1589ef4f8a2b0","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The UN Office for Disarmament Affairs lists the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a party to the Pelindaba Treaty, which prohibits nuclear weapons and requires peaceful nuclear activities to have full-scope IAEA safeguards and high physical-protection standards.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.3","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The treaty status is ongoing and applies during 2023, but the source does not identify a new 2023 action.","ruler_attribution":"The treaty obligation is attributable to the DRC state; the document does not establish a specific 2023 decision by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not report 2023 compliance, enforcement, funding, inspections, or violations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-dba1eee8602d7f00","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"On 22 March 2023, the BCC Monetary Policy Committee raised the policy rate from 8.25% to 9% in response to internal and external risks; it reported expected 2023 growth of 8%, expected inflation of 9.7%, cumulative inflation of 5.1% by 17 March, and 4.2 billion dollars in foreign-exchange reserves.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.3","5B.9","5B.10","8B.2","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns macroeconomic management during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The decision was made by the central bank's Monetary Policy Committee under its governor, not directly by Tshisekedi; the source also reported continued adherence to a pact barring monetary financing of the budget deficit.","limitations":["The article reports the BCC's assessment and decision but does not establish presidential direction or later inflation outcomes.","Projected growth and inflation were forecasts."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents include government, institutional, media, advocacy, and historical contextual sources with differing evidentiary authority.","Several records concern actions by ministers, agencies, the central bank, provincial authorities, or the CENI rather than decisions personally made by Félix Tshisekedi; attribution is therefore limited to the level supported by each source.","The evidence includes plans, announcements, and institutional findings but relatively little independently verified information about completed implementation, causal outcomes, or end-of-period change."]}
